short_description: A standing calf raise against a wall that strengthens the calf muscles with added balance support.
how_to: Stand facing a wall with your fingertips lightly touching it.
Place your feet hip-width apart with toes pointing forward.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Keep your body upright throughout.
Rise to your full height on each rep.
Lower your heels with control.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't lean heavily into the wall.
Don't drop your heels quickly.
Don't let your ankles roll outward.
Don't rush the movement.

short_description: A travelling plank that challenges core stability and shoulder strength as you step side to side.
how_to: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Step your right hand and right foot out to the right.
Follow with your left hand and left foot.
Repeat in the other direction for one rep.
Keep your hips level throughout.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
Keep your core engaged.
Keep your hips level as you step.
Move with a steady, controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't let your hips sway side to side.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A leaning side-raise stretch that opens the hips and lengthens the inner thigh and lateral trunk.
how_to: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Lean to one side and place your hand on your thigh for support.
Raise the opposite arm overhead and reach away.
Hold for a breath, then return to centre.
Alternate sides for the full set.
correct: Keep your chest open and facing forward.
Breathe slowly into the stretch.
Keep a soft bend in both knees.
Reach long through your fingertips.
mistakes: Don't round your upper back.
Don't force the stretch.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't let your hips shift backward.

short_description: A full-body warm-up movement that stretches the hamstrings and activates the core and shoulders.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Walk your hands out until you reach a plank position.
Walk your hands back toward your feet.
Stand up and repeat.
correct: Keep your legs as straight as your flexibility allows.
Keep your core engaged in the plank position.
Move at a slow, deliberate pace.
Keep your back flat as you hinge.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back arch in the plank.
Don't bend your knees excessively.
Don't rush through the steps.
Don't let your hips rise too high as you walk in.

short_description: A standing quad stretch using a wall for balance that lengthens the front of the thigh.
how_to: Stand next to a wall and place one hand on it for support.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute.
Grasp your ankle with your free hand.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch in your thigh.
Switch legs and repeat.
correct: Keep your knees together.
Keep your body upright throughout.
Breathe steadily.
Hold the stretch without bouncing.
mistakes: Don't lean forward from your hips.
Don't force the stretch.
Don't let your standing knee lock out.
Don't hold your breath.

exercise_name: Sumo Squat Calf Raises with Wall
short_description: A wide-stance squat hold combined with calf raises against a wall that targets the inner thighs, glutes and calves.
how_to: Stand facing a wall with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Touch the wall lightly with your fingertips for balance.
Lower into a sumo squat and hold the position.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower your heels.
Repeat the calf raise from the squat hold.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down in the squat base.
Keep your chest upright throughout.
Move with control on each raise.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast into the squat.
Don't lean heavily on the wall.
Don't rush the calf raises.

short_description: A calf raise with toes turned out that targets the outer portion of the calf muscles.
how_to: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing outward.
Place your hands on your hips or hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Keep your body upright throughout.
Rise to your full height on each rep.
Lower with control.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't let your ankles roll inward.
Don't drop your heels quickly.
Don't rush the movement.
Don't lock your knees.

short_description: A single-leg hopping drill that develops calf power and ankle stability on one leg at a time.
how_to: Stand on one foot with a slight bend in your knee.
Spring off the ball of your foot and hop lightly.
Land on the same foot and immediately spring again.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
correct: Land softly.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your core engaged for balance.
Stay on the ball of your foot throughout.
mistakes: Don't land hard.
Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't let your heel slam down.
Don't lean excessively to one side.

short_description: A standing calf stretch that lengthens the gastrocnemius and soleus by pressing the heel into the floor.
how_to: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it.
Step one foot back and press your heel firmly into the floor.
Keep the back leg straight and lean gently forward.
Hold where you feel the stretch in your calf.
Switch legs and repeat.
correct: Keep your back heel flat on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight for the upper calf.
Breathe steadily.
Keep your hips square and forward.
mistakes: Don't let your back heel lift.
Don't force the stretch.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't rotate your back foot inward.

short_description: A supine leg raise that strengthens the hip flexors and lower abdominals while protecting the lower back.
how_to: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise both legs together to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without letting them touch the floor.
Repeat for the full set.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your legs straight throughout.
Lower your legs with control.
Breathe out as you raise your legs.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't let your legs drop quickly.
Don't bend your knees to make it easier.
